english: Well then, I disagree that something which is the same as a coffee cup is contradictory to something which is contradictory to a coffee cup. If you do disagree, then let's consider something which is the same as a coffee cup. It is too contradictory to something which is contradictory to a coffee cup, Because (1) it is separate from that which is contradictory to a coffee cup; and (2) there exist no examples of things which are both it, and also contradictory to a coffee cup.
